- v1: always-det (97.5%) due to connect/disconnect matching everything
- v2: always-internal (99.5%) because science keywords barely appear in ScienceWorld action text

This is actually a great finding for the paper:
1. v1 keyword router ≈ always-det (trivially correct for the wrong reason)


2. v2 keyword router ≈ always-internal (trivially wrong)
3. Neither captures the actual routing mechanism (death avoidance)

The keyword heuristic fundamentally can't work here because the routing signal lives at the episode level, not in individual action descriptions. - internal-preferred (~1-2%): det died + int alive, 或 both alive int > det  
```markdown
- no-preference (~60%): both died, 或 both alive tie

## GPU 时间估算
- 双卡并行
- 数据复用节省
- 总计 ~Xh

## 预期产出
- plan-012: death decomposition 表/图 (论文 Table 1 + Figure 1)
- plan-005: routing pattern heatmap
- plan-002: router SFT diagnostic probe
- plan-011: rule-based vs learned comparison

## 提交命令
[episode_level_collection.py 的具体命令]
```

### 注意
- 提案中标注哪些 tasks 还在等预筛结果
- 给出 "最小方案"（只用已完成 tasks）和 "完整方案"（等预筛全部完成）两个版本
- GPU 时间要精确计算（每个 task 的 (20-existing) episodes × 2 modes × ~4 min/episode）

```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing

cat src/episode_level_collection.py
```

```json
}
```

```bash
# 1. 模拟采集输出（用已有 prescreening 数据）

# 复制 prescreening 数据作为 episodes.jsonl

# 2. 跑 death_aware_labeling

# 3. 检查输出

head -3 results/test_pipeline/labeled/sft_triples.jsonl
```

如果数据路径/文件名不对，先 ls 确认实际文件名再调整。
